purpose.zh: 练肩袖，提升肩内旋控制
purpose.en: Build the rotator cuff and control shoulder internal rotation.

text.zh: 肘贴身体约90度，前臂向腹部内收
text.en: Keep your elbow at your side at 90 degrees and rotate your forearm in

text.zh: 侧对固定点站直，膝盖微屈
text.en: Stand tall side-on to the anchor with soft knees.

text.zh: 慢慢放回，只在无痛范围内做
text.en: Return slowly and stay in a pain-free range.

commonErrors.en: Letting the elbow drift away from your side.
Turning the trunk instead of the shoulder.

cautions.zh: 用轻阻力弹力带，检查固定点牢固；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a light band and check the anchor is secure; stop if you feel pain.
